location_description:
Sanctuary is a town in Parker County, Texas, United States.  The population was 329 at the 2010 census, and was incorporated in the early 1980s.


== Geography ==
Sanctuary is located at 32°54′32″N 97°35′3″W (32.908822, –97.584209).According to the United States Census Bureau, the town has a total area of 0.3 square miles (0.78 km2), all of it land.
